frozen_regression.frontier_generation: exact R48Q center control plus r47x.frontier one-swap reachable-fixpoint generation, deduplicated by canonical root hash
frozen_regression.legacy_trajectory: for every root, reconstruct exact R48Q smallest-width4-safe-pivot trajectory using frozen R48O/R47M semantics and independent replay
frozen_regression.support_first_replay: starting from the same root, replay the same selected pivot at each legacy state using the frozen R49B support-first normalization; independently recompute every support-first candidate
frozen_regression.exact_match_continuation: continue to the next legacy pivot only if support-first final hash exactly equals the legacy final hash
frozen_regression.safe_syntactic_divergence: if a support-first nonterminal successor has a different hash but remains eligible, no-fresh-variable and persisted width<=4, record SAFE_SYNTACTIC_DIVERGENCE and stop replaying that root without declaring a scientific failure
frozen_regression.safe_terminal_divergence: if support-first terminates before the legacy trajectory ends, require independent terminal certificate, same SAT/UNSAT polarity as the completed legacy root trajectory, and successful SAT root reconstruction when SAT; then record SAFE_TERMINAL_DIVERGENCE
frozen_regression.hard_regression: candidate missing, independent replay failure, nonterminal loss of eligibility/no-fresh-variable/width4 safety, failed SAT root reconstruction, or terminal polarity mismatch

required_metrics: aggregate legacy versus support-first SA-BVE counts on replayed pivots
number of replayed pivots where support-first mode was actually used
